text:
jess: FYI launched v1.3 yesterday — getting a couple of bug reports on embed truncation and a UX flake on session restore. Can we quick triage?

mario: saw 2 S1 from Customer A on embed truncation, logs show token cutoff at 512.

li: is that due to the new truncation logic? I pushed that change in #eng-runtime last week.

jess: yes that PR bumped default max context for hosted models, might have regressed prefix handling.

devin: For planning, propose: patch for bug (hotfix) to Dedicated + Hosted canary; backlog the small UX tweak for next minor. Anyone object?

nora: +1 on canary. Need acceptance criteria for hotfix: reproduce with customer payload, confirm no perf regression (<5% p99 delta), and update release notes.

mario: I'll own repro and test. estimate 1d to get reliable repro and test vectors.

li: I'll prepare branch and roll a canary to dedicated pool after mario approves.

jess: product-side: which customers to notify? propose emailing the three paying customers hit by S1, and posting a short release note on status.redwood.ai.

devin: schedule: freeze cutoff 14:00 UTC, canary at 16:00 UTC, full rollout tomorrow if green.

nora: decision: do not pull the session-restore UX tweak into the hotfix — surface area too big.

jess: agreed. Add a follow-on ticket for UX with ACs and link to session-restore test harness.

product-bot: Ticket created: PROD-3245 (hotfix) and PROD-3246 (UX follow-on) by jess

mario: created regression test in CI, using env toggle. snippet: ```ENV_EMBED_TRIM=true```

li: noted. I'll handle the canary rollout plan with ops and document the rollback window.

jess: thanks team — once canary is green I'll update the roadmap doc and close this thread :thumbsup:
